description: Scenario-based conditional crosswalk. Each scenario defines the allowed legacy-atom to OKVED2-class flow graph. The graph is compiled as hard flow-conservation equations; no optimizer-selected profile is promoted to a reconstructed value. A value is accepted only after feasible min/max certification collapses to a point or one publication bucket.
source_basis: CBR legacy publication node names and hierarchy
published national, regional and federal-district SORS aggregates
